decision_skill.name: prefer_direct_daily_seasonality
decision_skill.description: Choose the simplest stable cycle-matched forecast when evidence shows recurring daily structure and no forecast-window event materially changes the target.
decision_skill.applicability: When candidates differ between direct daily repetition and a more complex weekday-plus-trend model, and verified evidence indicates that apparent historical anomalies were resolved measurement defects or target-neutral interference.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Select the candidate whose conditional median matches the immediately relevant daily cycle; disregard resolved telemetry outages and disturbances explicitly stated to affect only measurement clarity, not the target.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when the daily cycle is unstable, the anomaly is confirmed to affect the target during the forecast window, the historical defect overlaps required training observations without a justified correction, or multiple weekday cycles provide stronger validated support than recent daily repetition.
